const int N=10005, S=N-2, T=N-1;
const int M=2000010;
const int INF=2000000000;

	to[++cnt]=y; nxt[cnt]=head[x]; head[x]=cnt;
	w[cnt]=flow; c[cnt]=cost;
	to[++cnt]=x; nxt[cnt]=head[y]; head[y]=cnt;
	w[cnt]=0; c[cnt]=-cost;
}

bool in_queue[N];

	memset(dist, 0x3f, sizeof(dist));

	while(!q.empty()){
		int x=q.front(); q.pop();
		in_queue[x]=false;
		for(int i=head[x];i;i=nxt[i]){
			int y=to[i];
			if(w[i^1] && dist[y]>dist[x]+c[i^1]){
				dist[y]=dist[x]+c[i^1];
				if(!in_queue[y]){
					q.push(y);
					in_queue[y]=true;
				}
			}
		}
	}
	return dist[S]<1e18;

	int flow=0; in_queue[x]=true;
	if(x==T) return limit;
	for(int i=head[x];i;i=nxt[i]){
		int y=to[i];
		if(!w[i] || in_queue[y]) continue;
		if(dist[x]!=dist[y]+c[i]) continue;

		flow+=t; total_cost+=t*c[i];
		if(flow==limit) break;
	}
	return flow;

	while(spfa()){
		memset(in_queue, 0, sizeof(in_queue));
		total_flow+=dfs(S, 101, total_cost);
	}
	return total_cost;
